executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and Enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-18 reviewed 8 current relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacities and improved yields can provide relief, but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
